Use docs/validation/EVIDENCE-TEMPLATE.md. Include exact model/resolution/firmware family, connection, media/accessories, OS/app, code SHA, profile version, finite test count and actual results. Omit serials and private payloads.

State which controls/workflows were tested and which were not. A report is not automatically qualification of the full model family.
